name: pi-telegram-bridge-native
description: Native pi-durable chat and memory host; dedicated test instances only until C7

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.native-build.json && node --input-type=module -e "await Promise.all(['durable/application', 'durable/child-worker', 'jobs-cli', 'price-watches', 'checkers/web-page-items', 'checkers/retail-product-price', 'checkers/gmail-inbox', 'checkers/ynab-unapproved'].map(name => import('./dist/src/' + name + '.js')))"
